summary: Iteration 14 - Google Ads Integration Testing. All 11 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified: NangoConnect shows all 4 integrations with Connect buttons, GoogleAdsDashboard shows not-connected state with Retry button, Settings page accessible with profile update and change password.
critical_code_review_comments: Google Ads integration properly implemented with correct error handling when not connected
GET /api/google-ads/customers returns 400 with 'Google Ads not connected. Please connect via Data Sources.' message
GET /api/google-ads/campaigns returns 400 with same clear message when not connected
POST /api/nango/connect-session works for google-ads provider and returns valid Nango token
POST /api/nango/save-connection correctly stores google-ads connection in DB
Frontend NangoConnect component renders all 4 integrations (Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google Sheets, Meta Ads) with proper data-testid attributes
Frontend GoogleAdsDashboard shows not-connected state with clear message and Retry button
Settings page has profile update (first_name, last_name, phone) and change password functionality
AI Chat deducts credits correctly (1 credit per query)
Note: Actual OAuth flow cannot be tested without real OAuth provider credentials configured in Nango dashboard
seed_data_creation: Test connections created and cleaned up during pytest runs
